answer: Mechanism: Unique-Execution Receipts. Each applicant gets challenge h(pubkey, epoch, knoll entropy) and must run a memory-hard VM for T steps, committing its trace in an onyx Merkle tree and returning the root plus a short fable string derived from final state. The registry rejects any fable/root already seen and verifies binding to pubkey and challenge; copied receipts fail. Attacker pays T memory-hard work plus persistent state per Sybil, and replay is useless.
